# qqbot-bridge

> Run an official QQ bot on a rooted Android phone as a Magisk/KernelSU module, using any OpenAI-compatible LLM. No VPS required. MIT license. Plain JavaScript (Node ESM), not TypeScript.

## Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/wzww886/qqbot-bridge (public)
- Language: JavaScript (Node.js >= 20, ESM, .mjs). Not TypeScript.
- Not related to DSH / DeepSeek Harness plugins, and not related to the project dsh-qqbot-bridge.
- Deployment: rooted Android phone via Magisk or KernelSU; PC/server also supported via npm.
- Default data dir: /data/adb/qqbot_bridge_data
- Features: per-session persona memory (fact extraction + summary compression + keyword recall), human-like segmented replies, emotion-matched stickers, proactive messages, watchdog self-healing, separate models for group and private chat.
- Limits: needs root; non-@ group messages require QQ advanced group permission; Node runtime not bundled.
- Install: download the zip from Releases and flash with Magisk/KernelSU, or unzip to /data/adb/modules/qqbot_bridge.
